name: vysor-clone
description: Mirrox — Android device mirror and control desktop app

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @vysor/adb && npm run build -w @vysor/mirror
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @vysor/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vysor/desktop
scripts.package: npm run vendor:arm64 && npm run build && npm run package -w @vysor/desktop
scripts.package:dmg: npm run vendor:arm64 && npm run build && npm run package:dmg -w @vysor/desktop
scripts.package:intel: npm run vendor:x64 && npm run build && npm run package:intel -w @vysor/desktop
scripts.package:all: npm run package:dmg && npm run package:intel
